speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
title: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Thabo Lebethoa spoke about “Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World”.

quotes.text: Many of us have experienced such moments when a conversation or discussion with a spouse, a child, a family member, a friend, a colleague, or a neighbor did not end as we hoped. In such moments, what may have begun as a simple exchange may leave us with feelings of anger, disappointment, frustration, or even regret.
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Whilst I was pondering about what to do, the words Jesus Christ spoke when He appeared to the people of Nephi in the Book of Mormon came to mind. He taught:
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: “Behold, this is not my doctrine, to stir up the hearts of men with anger, one against another; but this is my doctrine, that such things should be done away” (3 Nephi 11:29–30 ; emphasis added).
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Many of us may wonder how we can receive more of the Savior’s light as we navigate through the daily challenges and struggles in our lives. We may be concerned about becoming self-reliant; meeting the demands placed upon us at school or at work; feeling inadequacy, fear, and doubt; dealing with the loss of a loved one; or simply knowing what to do with our lives. Whatever concerns, challenges, and struggles we may have in our lives, the answer is always Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Jesus Christ can bring light in our moments of darkness and restore hope where there is hopelessness. He knows where we have been, where we are, and where we need to be. Through Him, today can be a new day and tomorrow can be a better day.
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Having faith in Jesus Christ means trusting that He understands our daily difficulties and knows how to help us rise above them because He has experienced all our pains, afflictions, and infirmities (see Alma 7:11–12). We need to trust that He is always ready to help us as we remember to “look unto [Him] in every thought” and “doubt not, fear not” (Doctrine and Covenants 6:36).
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In the October 2024 general conference, President Dieter F. Uchtdorf taught: “Strong faith in Jesus Christ doesn’t happen overnight. No, in this mortal world, it’s the thorns and thistles of doubt that grow spontaneously. The healthy, fruitful tree of faith requires intentional effort” (“ Nourish the Roots, and the Branches Will Grow,” Liahona, Nov. 2024, 102).
quotes.speaker: Elder Thabo Lebethoa
quotes.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Dallin H. Oaks in an address to BYU students taught that “strong faith requires more than strong desire. It means daily trying, one step at a time, with prayer and scripture study” (“ Coming Closer to Jesus Christ ” [Brigham Young University devotional, Feb. 10, 2026], 2, speeches.byu.edu).

scriptures.text: For verily, verily I say unto you, he that hath the spirit of contention is not of me, but is of the devil, who is the father of contention, and he stirreth up the hearts of men to contend with anger, one with another. Behold, this is not my doctrine, to stir up the hearts of men with anger, one against another; but this is my doctrine, that such things should be done away.

And behold, I am the light and the life of the world; and I have drunk out of that bitter cup which the Father hath given me, and have glorified the Father in taking upon me the sins of the world, in the which I have suffered the will of the Father in all things from the beginning.
Behold, thou knowest that thou hast inquired of me and I did enlighten thy mind; and now I tell thee these things that thou mayest know that thou hast been enlightened by the Spirit of truth;
And as I have prayed among you even so shall ye pray in my church, among my people who do repent and are baptized in my name. Behold I am the light; I have set an example for you.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

And he shall go forth, suffering pains and afflictions and temptations of every kind; and this that the word might be fulfilled which saith he will take upon him the pains and the sicknesses of his people. And he will take upon him death, that he may loose the bands of death which bind his people; and he will take upon him their infirmities, that his bowels may be filled with mercy, according to the flesh, that he may know according to the flesh how to succor his people according to their infirmities.
Look unto me in every thought; doubt not, fear not.

And he will take upon him death, that he may loose the bands of death which bind his people; and he will take upon him their infirmities, that his bowels may be filled with mercy, according to the flesh, that he may know according to the flesh how to succor his people according to their infirmities.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
